title: Sean Payton says that Broncos WR Pat Bryant is having a ‘heck of a camp’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton says that Broncos WR Pat Bryant is having a ‘heck of a camp’
sources.description: The story of Broncos Camp this summer has been the emergence of second-year wide receiver Pat Bryant. We saw the beginnings of this breakout last season, but it carried over into the offseason and now into camp and the preseason. He stayed healthy and was making plays throughout camp, catching everything thrown his way, and […]
